observations: Yellow portable gasoline generator with black protective frame and handlebars.
Brand 'ELEPAQ' and 'GASOLINE GENERATOR' printed on the front panel in photo 0.
Model 'FM157GC' printed on the lower front panel in photo 0.
Control panel features a digital display, fuel gauge, and multiple outlets (AC, DC, and 12V).
A black engine is mounted on the left side of the unit.
The unit is on a wheeled base with a single rear wheel and a yellow front wheel.
A red and white box with 'EAE 2000' is visible in the background.
The generator appears to be in a storage or workshop environment.

claims.evidence: The engine is not shown running; the condition of the engine and fuel system cannot be confirmed from a still photo.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized, have internal damage, or have worn bearings.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine starting and running smoothly.

risks.risk: The fuel system or carburetor may be clogged or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing the generator running with the fuel cap open and no leaks.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full service and repair

risks.risk: The generator may have electrical faults or blown fuses.
risks.proof: A video showing the digital display powered on and all outlets functioning.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the engine starting and running.
Video of the generator producing power with all outlets connected.
Photo of the engine compartment showing the oil level and condition.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
